name: Add tier — mount an existing tier and activate it
description: Agent runs /add-tier, calls gitlore-add-tier with the intent on stdin; the script mounts the tier remote, activates it in memory/.gitlore-tiers as its own final step, recomposes the tier's pointer lines into the root index, and commits the mount itself under its canned message on the clean store
prompt: /add-tier The acme team already has a shared memory tier and I want this repo to join it. It mounts as `acme`, and its clone URL is {{EVAL_REPO}}/.tier-remote.git — mount it and make it active.
